services.name: GetPartnerGetClientMainTypeByClient1
services.description:
Determines the main client type (ClientMainType1) of a client so that the correct interface for reading the client data can be called.
ClientMainType1.NATURAL_PERSON -> CreateNaturalPerson ClientMainType1.MULTIPLE_NATURAL_PERSONS -> CreateMultipleNaturalPerson ClientMainType1.ORGANISATION -> CreateOrganisation

Error handling:
This method may return the following gRPC error codes with additional error details:

- INVALID_ARGUMENT
  * common.finnova.com.ValidationFailed:
    The transmitted data does not conform to the validation requirements.
    The validation of the input parameters for determining the main client type has failed. The parameter 'clientKey' is invalid or missing.
 
@since 5.2025
